title: BLAST SHOVE AND BIG HIT AIM NUDGE
why: His g-3: A shove only. His g-6: A small nudge on big hits. Watch: being shoved by your own frag or rocket up close must feel fair, and a shove next to deep water or a doorway must read; the aim nudge is felt most in long duels and must never read as input lag or a bad mouse.
now: Blasts push surviving players away using wall collision. Incoming non-blast hits of 30 or more nudge the gun for a quarter second, with no random draw, stacking, reticle movement or new text. Both seats apply their own landed-hit rules.
